---
output:
  word_document:
    reference_docx: reference.docx
    md_extensions: "-tex_math_single_backslash"
params:
  project_dir: "."
  data_rds: "output/prepared_data.rds"
  response_id: ""
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source(file.path(params$project_dir, "R", "functions.R"))

dat  <- readRDS(params$data_rds)
id   <- params$response_id
resp <- dat$responses %>% filter(ResponseId == id)
if (nrow(resp) != 1) stop("Response ", id, " not found in the prepared data.")

ans <- dat$answers %>% filter(ResponseId == id)
r   <- as.list(dat$raw_numeric[dat$raw_numeric$ResponseId == id, ][1, ])
qs  <- dat$qstatus %>%
  filter(ResponseId == id, !is_feedback) %>%
  left_join(dat$questions %>% select(tag, cols), by = "tag")

# Section order: as set in run_reports.R, then any other non-feedback block
blocks_present <- as.character(unique(qs$block))
section_order <- c(intersect(dat$settings$applicant_sections, blocks_present),
                   setdiff(blocks_present, dat$settings$applicant_sections))

submitted_on <- if (resp$finished) resp$recorded else resp$end
checks <- application_checks(r, as.Date(submitted_on))

value_of <- function(column) {
  v <- ans$value[ans$col == column]
  if (length(v) == 0) character() else v[[1]]
}
```

```{r title, results = "asis"}
cat('::: {custom-style="Title"}\n', md_escape(resp$training_title %||% "Training title not provided"),
    "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
cat('::: {custom-style="Subtitle"}\n',
    md_escape(paste0("Training application review: ",
                     resp$provider %||% "Provider not provided", " | ", resp$ResponseId)),
    "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
```

# Application summary

```{r summary-table}
status_text <- if (resp$finished) {
  "Submitted"
} else {
  sprintf("NOT SUBMITTED: stopped at %s%% progress", resp$progress)
}
summary_tbl <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Field, ~Value,
  "Response ID",          resp$ResponseId,
  "Training title",       resp$training_title %||% "-",
  "Provider/organization", resp$provider %||% "-",
  "Primary contact",      resp$contact_name %||% "-",
  "Contact email",        resp$contact_email %||% "-",
  "Submission status",    status_text,
  "Started",              fmt_dt(resp$start),
  if (resp$finished) "Submitted" else "Last activity", fmt_dt(if (resp$finished) resp$recorded else resp$end),
  "Time spent in the form", fmt_duration(resp$duration_sec)
)
ft <- flextable(summary_tbl) %>%
  ft_style() %>%
  delete_part("header") %>%
  bold(j = 1) %>%
  width(j = 1, width = 1.9) %>%
  width(j = 2, width = 4.6) %>%
  set_table_properties(layout = "fixed")
ft <- ft %>% bold(i = 1, j = 2)
if (!resp$finished) ft <- ft %>% color(i = 6, j = 2, color = "#B3261E") %>% bold(i = 6, j = 2)
ft
```

```{r attempts-note, results = "asis"}
if (!resp$finished) {
  cat(styled(paste0(
    "⚠ This application was not submitted. The respondent's last answer was '",
    resp$last_title %||% "none", "' in ", as.character(resp$last_block %||% "-"),
    ". Questions after that point are marked NOT REACHED."), "Missing Flag"), "\n\n")
}
if (!resp$has_contact) {
  cat(styled(paste0(
    "⚠ The respondent stopped before entering provider and contact details. ",
    "Use the response ID to refer to this entry."), "Missing Flag"), "\n\n")
}
```

# Completeness by section

```{r completeness}
by_section <- qs %>%
  filter(!status %in% c("Not applicable"), !optional) %>%
  group_by(Section = as.character(block)) %>%
  summarise(
    `Required questions` = n(),
    Answered = sum(status == "Answered"),
    `Missing or incomplete` = sum(status %in% c("Missing", "Incomplete")),
    `Not reached` = sum(status == "Not reached"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Status = case_when(
      Answered == `Required questions` ~ "Complete",
      `Not reached` == `Required questions` ~ "Not reached",
      `Missing or incomplete` > 0 & `Not reached` > 0 ~
        sprintf("Missing %d; %d not reached", `Missing or incomplete`, `Not reached`),
      `Missing or incomplete` > 0 ~ sprintf("Missing %d", `Missing or incomplete`),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("Not reached: %d", `Not reached`)
    ),
    Section = factor(Section, levels = section_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Section) %>%
  mutate(Section = as.character(Section))

flextable(by_section) %>%
  ft_style() %>%
  align(j = 2:5, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  ft_status_colors(j = "Status")
```

```{r attention, results = "asis"}
attention <- qs %>%
  filter(status %in% c("Missing", "Incomplete", "Not reached")) %>%
  mutate(block = factor(as.character(block), levels = section_order)) %>%
  arrange(block, order)

cat("## Required questions needing attention\n\n")
missing_q <- attention %>% filter(status != "Not reached")
not_reached <- attention %>% filter(status == "Not reached") %>%
  count(block, name = "n")
if (nrow(attention) == 0) {
  cat(styled("All required questions were answered.", "OK Flag"), "\n\n")
} else {
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(missing_q))) {
    a <- missing_q[k, ]
    lbl <- if (a$status == "Missing") "missing" else "partly answered"
    cat("- ", md_escape(paste0(as.character(a$block), ": ", a$title, " (", lbl, ")")), "\n", sep = "")
  }
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(not_reached))) {
    cat("- ", md_escape(sprintf("%s: %d required question(s) not reached",
                                as.character(not_reached$block[k]), not_reached$n[k])), "\n", sep = "")
  }
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r answers, results = "asis"}
mime_short <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ "",
    str_detect(x, "pdf") ~ "PDF",
    str_detect(x, "wordprocessingml|msword") ~ "Word",
    str_detect(x, "presentationml|powerpoint") ~ "PowerPoint",
    str_detect(x, "spreadsheetml|excel|csv") ~ "Excel/CSV",
    str_detect(x, "^image/") ~ "Image",
    str_detect(x, "^video/") ~ "Video",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

flag_for <- function(status) {
  switch(status,
    Missing = styled("⚠ MISSING: required question not answered", "Missing Flag"),
    Incomplete = styled("⚠ INCOMPLETE: required parts are blank (marked below)", "Missing Flag"),
    `Not reached` = styled("⚠ NOT REACHED: applicant stopped before this question", "Missing Flag"),
    `Optional - blank` = styled("Not provided (optional)", "Muted"),
    NULL)
}

answer_md <- function(q) {
  cols <- q$cols[[1]]
  switch(q$type,
    text = {
      v <- value_of(cols[1])
      if (length(v) == 0) return("")
      out <- md_text(v)
      if (q$tag %in% names(word_count_questions)) {
        rng <- word_count_questions[[q$tag]]
        out <- paste0(out, "\n\n", styled(sprintf("%d words%s", word_count(v),
                     if (is.na(rng)) "" else paste0(" (requested: ", rng, ")")), "Muted"))
      }
      out
    },
    choice = {
      v <- value_of(cols[1])
      if (length(v) == 0) "" else if (length(v) == 1) md_escape(v)
      else paste0("- ", md_escape(v), collapse = "\n")
    },
    matrix = {
      rows <- ans %>% filter(col %in% cols, lengths(value) > 0)
      if (nrow(rows) == 0) return("")
      paste0("- **", md_escape(rows$sublabel), "**: ",
             map_chr(rows$value, ~ md_escape(paste(.x, collapse = "; "))), collapse = "\n")
    },
    text_group = {
      spec <- required_parts[[q$tag]]
      req <- if (is.null(spec)) character() else if (identical(spec, "all")) cols else spec
      lines <- map_chr(cols, function(cc) {
        v <- value_of(cc)
        lab <- ans$sublabel[ans$col == cc][1]
        if (length(v) == 0) {
          if (cc %in% req && q$status != "Not reached")
            return(paste0("- ", md_escape(lab), ": ", styled("MISSING", "Missing Flag")))
          return(NA_character_)
        }
        paste0("- ", md_escape(lab), ": ", md_escape(paste(v, collapse = "; ")))
      })
      paste(na.omit(lines), collapse = "\n")
    },
    upload = {
      get <- function(suffix) { cc <- cols[str_detect(cols, paste0("_", suffix, "$"))]; v <- value_of(cc); if (length(v)) v else NA }
      if (is.na(get("Name")) && is.na(get("Id"))) return("")
      paste0("File: **", md_escape(get("Name") %||% "(no name)"), "** (",
             md_escape(paste(c(mime_short(get("Type")), fmt_bytes(get("Size"))), collapse = ", ")),
             ")\\\n", styled(paste0("Download from the response in Qualtrics. File ID: ", get("Id")), "Muted"))
    },
    ""
  )
}

for (sec in section_order) {
  sq <- qs %>% filter(as.character(block) == sec, status != "Not applicable") %>% arrange(order)
  if (nrow(sq) == 0) next
  cat("# ", md_escape(sec), "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (all(sq$status %in% c("Not reached", "Optional - blank")) && any(sq$status == "Not reached")) {
    cat(styled("\u26A0 SECTION NOT REACHED: the applicant stopped before this section. None of its questions were answered.",
               "Missing Flag"), "\n\n", sep = "")
    next
  }
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(sq))) {
    q <- sq[k, ]
    cat('::: {custom-style="Question"}\n', md_escape(q$title), "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
    f <- flag_for(q$status)
    body <- answer_md(q)
    if (!is.null(f)) cat(f, "\n\n", sep = "")
    if (nzchar(body)) cat(body, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
